summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans two complementary layers: model repositories like Hugging Face that host and distribute model weights, and developer-facing inference platforms like Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow that make running those models easy via local runtimes or hosted APIs. As of 2026, Hugging Face has crossed 3 million public models (adding roughly a million per year), though downloads are highly concentrated—the top 200 models account for nearly half of all downloads, and China has surpassed the U.S. in monthly download share. Inference platforms differentiate on latency, pricing, model breadth, and whether they target local/private deployment or scalable cloud serving.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository and community hub for hosting, sharing, and discovering AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus a serverless Inference API and Inference Endpoints for deployment.
platforms.model_count: ~3 million+ public models (crossed 3,011,630 in August 2026, on pace to add another million+ in 2026)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public hosting and limited inference; Pro at ~$9/month; pay-as-you-go Inference Endpoints and Inference Providers billed by compute/usage; Enterprise Hub plans available
features: Largest open model and dataset registry
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Inference Providers routing to partner backends
Download stats and model cards for discovery
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers who need the broadest selection of open models and datasets with community tooling and flexible deployment options

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A lightweight local runtime that lets developers download and run open LLMs and multimodal models on their own machines (Mac, Linux, Windows) with a simple CLI and local API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (e.g., Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma, DeepSeek, Phi families), plus any GGUF model importable from Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free and open source for local use; no per-token cost since inference runs on your own hardware (optional cloud offering for larger models)
features: Runs fully offline / on-device for privacy
Modelfile customization for prompts and parameters
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally for prototyping, offline use, or cost-free experimentation

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and deploying open-source models via API using containerized definitions (Cog), covering LLMs, image/video generation, audio, and more.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models across modalities (text, image, video, audio)
platforms.pricing: Usage-based pay-per-second of compute (billed by hardware type) or per-run pricing; no subscription required
features: Run models via simple HTTP API
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Strong catalog of image/video/audio generation models
platforms.best_for: App developers who want to add AI features (especially generative image/video) via API without managing infrastructure

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A developer inference cloud offering fast, scalable serving of open-source LLMs and other models, plus fine-tuning and dedicated GPU endpoints.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, embeddings, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference (tiered by model size), plus hourly pricing for dedicated GPU instances and fine-tuning jobs
features: Supports LLMs, embeddings, image, and code models
platforms.best_for: Teams building production LLM applications on open models who need scalable, cost-efficient hosted inference and fine-tuning

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference platform focused on fast, low-latency serving of open LLMs, vision, and audio models, with tuning for production workloads and agents.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FireFunction, vision and audio models)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing scaled by model size, plus on-demand dedicated deployments billed by GPU-hour
features: Fine-tuning (including LoRA) and custom model hosting
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises needing the fastest, production-grade inference for open models and agentic/function-calling workloads

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer inference platform (strong presence in the China/Asia market) providing cost-efficient hosted APIs for a wide range of open-source LLMs, image, audio, and video models.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models including DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, and various image/video/audio models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token / pay-per-usage with competitive low pricing; free credits and some free model tiers commonly offered
features: Broad catalog of Chinese and global open models
Text, image, video, and audio generation endpoints
Popular among developers in Asia aligned with China's rising open-model share
platforms.best_for: Developers seeking low-cost access to leading Chinese and global open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM) via a unified API

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An inference platform built on custom LPU hardware delivering extremely high token-generation speeds for open LLMs via a hosted API.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Qwen, Mixtral, Gemma, Whisper, and others)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token pricing per model, with a free developer tier and rate limits
features: Simple developer onboarding with free tier
platforms.best_for: Developers who prioritize raw inference speed and low latency for real-time or interactive open-model applications

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API aggregator and router that gives access to many open and proprietary models across multiple providers through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models from dozens of underlying providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go passthrough pricing per model with a small routing margin; prepaid credits
features: Single API for many providers and models
Automatic fallback and provider routing by price/latency
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access to many models with easy switching and cost optimization
